rationale: Base station storage is at 100% with loop recording disabled, and the active fault code is E-402. Per the fault-code reference, when storage reaches 98%+ with loop recording off, new events stop being recorded — which explains why no clips exist for the last three weeks. No account compromise is indicated; the fix is to enable loop recording or format storage after exporting clips.

repair_steps: Guide customer to export any important clips from the base station storage.
In Base Station Settings > Storage, enable loop recording.
If loop recording cannot be enabled or customer prefers, format storage after export.
Confirm E-402 clears and new events are recorded.
output.customer_reply: Your account is secure and no recordings were deleted. The base station storage became full (100%) and loop recording was off, so new events stopped being saved. To fix, we'll enable loop recording or format storage after exporting any clips you want to keep. This will allow new events to be recorded again.

args.query: E-402 storage full events not recorded

lines: storage used 100%; loop recording disabled; E-402

args.query: E-402 storage full events not recorded

results.text: Base station storage at or above 98 percent with loop recording disabled. Frontline action: enable loop recording or format storage.

Event clips are stored on the base station's internal eMMC (HB-100: 16 GB, HB-200: 32 GB). When loop recording is disabled and storage reaches 98 percent, new events are not recorded and error E-402 is shown. Enable loop recording in Base Station Settings > Storage, or format the storage after exporting clips.

Base station online, live view works on local network, but no event notifications; E-503 every few minutes. Router restart and DNS reset did not help. Escalated; expired device certificate on backend. Escalated correctly.

complaint: The system stopped saving event clips. A break-in attempt happened at a neighbour's house, so I wanted to check my camera footage and there is nothing for the last three weeks! Did somebody delete my recordings? Is my account hacked? I haven't received any password-change emails.
